title: Term Left to Contract End and the Anniversary Review Scale
content:
**Q. Under Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, what rule governs term left in anniversary security review?**

A. The review requirement is scaled by the term left, the whole months from the handling date to the contract end date: fewer than 12 scale it by 0.75, 12 up to 23 scale it by 0.90, and 24 or more leave it unscaled. Scaling multiplies the review requirement by the figure shown.

## Questions answered

**How are whole months counted?** In calendar months from the handling date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the handling date; a final part-month is not counted.

**Where do the bands break?**

| Handling date | Contract end date | Whole months left | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 October 2026 | 3 October 2027 | 11 | 0.75 |
| 4 October 2026 | 4 October 2027 | 12 | 0.90 |
| 4 October 2026 | 30 September 2028 | 23 | 0.90 |
| 4 October 2026 | 4 October 2028 | 24 | 1 |

**What does the scale do to a requirement?** A requirement of $58500.00 with 11 whole months left becomes 58500.00 multiplied by 0.75, that is $43875.00 (hypothetical).
